verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
You are Holy (girls echo)
You are Mighty (girls echo)
You are worthy (girls echo)
Worthy of praise (girls echo)

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
I will follow (girls echo)
I will listen (girls echo)
I will love You (girls echo)
All of my days (girls echo)

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
I will sing to (You're the Lord of Lords)
And Worship (You're the King of Kings)
The king who (You're the Mighty God)
Is worthy (Lord of Everything)

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
I will love and (You're Emmanuel)
Adore Him (You're the Great I Am)
I will bow down (You're the Prince of Peace)
Before Him (Who is the Lamb)

verse.name: c1c
verse.lines:
I will sing to (You're the Living God)
And worship (You're my Saving Grace)
The king who (You will reign forever)
Is worthy (You are ancient of days)

verse.name: c1d
verse.lines:
I will love and (You're the Alpha, Omega)
Adore Him (Beginning and end)
I will bow down (You're my Saviour, Messiah)
Before Him (Redeemer and friend)

verse.name: c1e
verse.lines:
Together:
You're my Prince of Peace and I will live my life for You
